access_links.label: Technology assumptions on the openmod wiki

description: IRENA is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Technology assumptions > IRENA", published or maintained by irena.org (publisher inferred from the link). Every ~3 years IRENA publishes a report on renewable power generation costs based on the IRENA Renewable Cost Database which contains ~15,000 data points for LCOE from projects for different generation technologies. A download link for the data used to produce the charts of the report can be requested online. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Technology assumptions" lists it under "IRENA". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support technology cost and performance assumption inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
licence: not stated on the wiki page (source page not read)
